description: This file contains implementation code for map adjustment functionality in the rusEfi firmware, including functions for initializing, adjusting map cells, running adjustments, and accessing adjustment data. Portions of the code are commented out.

methods.name: initMapAdjuster
methods.description: Initializes the map adjustment process by resetting average tables.

methods.name: adjustCell
methods.description: Adjusts a specific cell in the map based on AFR measurements if enough data is available.

methods.name: runMapAdjustments
methods.description: Runs adjustments across all map cells, applying callback functions as needed.

methods.name: addAfr
methods.description: Adds a new AFR measurement at a specific RPM and key position.

methods.name: getMultiplier
methods.description: Retrieves the current multiplier value for a specific RPM and key.
